name: handover
title: Pipeline handover record
for_each: select id,code from pipelines order by code

sections.title: Mapping
sections.sql: select value->>'input' as source_field,value->>'output' as destination_field,value->>'type' as value_type from pipelines p,jsonb_array_elements(p.config->'columns') where p.id=$1

sections.title: Recent runs
sections.sql: select status,as_of,input_rows,inserted,changed,unchanged,actor from runs where pipeline_id=$1 order by created_at desc
sections.note: Reconcile these figures against the source before accepting a handover.

name: transfer-certificate
title: Transfer reconciliation record
for_each: select id,code from pipelines order by code

sections.title: Run evidence
sections.sql: select id,status,as_of,source_hash,revision,input_rows,inserted,changed,unchanged,actor from runs where pipeline_id=$1 order by created_at desc
sections.note: Internal record, not a certificate of legal compliance.

sections.title: Outstanding work
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_on from actions where pipeline_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_on
